blocks.heading: Search the pack
blocks.body:
Find in Files is the audit. A mark that is not on your list is not a plan. It is a surprise.

The video shows grouped marks. Watch for the idea. Do not design groups this week.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: A list of every mark.

This lab can fail. Fail when: A mark remains without a list line, or you deleted the expert step’s words while removing a mark, or the list is empty because you skipped Find in Files.

Expected: The list matches the pack. Every remaining mark has a meaning. Files clean.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to A list of every mark.
blocks.intro: How to A list of every mark. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: A list of every mark
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Find in Files for audience= and platform= across the kitepump folder. Also search product=, otherprops=, props=, and rev= :  extra mark fields some files use. If you cannot explain one, it goes on the delete list.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Write oxygen-bootcamp-work/week5/condition-census.txt: each hit, the value, one-line meaning, keep or delete.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Delete any value you cannot explain. Do not replace it with a different joke.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Leave audience=expert and platform=print if they still match yesterday’s meanings.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: If you find grouped marks from a paste, simplify to one attribute unless you can draw the group.

blocks.summary: The list matches the pack. Every remaining mark has a meaning. Files clean.

blocks.q: Find in Files shows audience="legacy". Nobody can say what legacy means. What do you do?
options: Keep it for the next person
Remove it, or write a meaning and a switch file action :  those are the two options
Set it on every page so it looks consistent
blocks.why: A mark with no meaning is a filter waiting to surprise you. Define it or delete it.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: A product name in the booklet vs a product mark on a step. Which one changes the word in the sentence?
options: The name in the booklet :  a mark shows or hides a chunk, it does not rename a word
blocks.why: A key changes the word. A condition shows, hides, or flags the chunk. Different tools.
